spanish: Y dominará desde Jacob, y hará perecer sobreviviente desde ciudad.

findings.issue: Qal jussive 3ms is indicative future; jussive force is unmarked.
The preposition leaves from, out of, and than open; «desde» locks a starting point and closes «que Jacob».

notes: Hiphil sequential 3ms stays causative hará perecer; singular sobreviviente and singular ciudad follow the tokens.
